compress_conversation: compress conversation messages by summarizing middle turns while protecting head and tail context
summarize_conversation_turns: summarize conversation turns into a structured handoff with Active Task, Completed Actions, and Pending User Asks sections
prune_old_tool_results: prune old tool results by replacing large outputs with informative one-line summaries and deduplicating identical content
truncate_tool_call_args_json: truncate long string values inside a tool-call arguments JSON blob while preserving JSON validity
summarize_tool_result: create an informative one-line summary of a tool call and its result for context compression
check_should_compress: check if conversation context exceeds the compression threshold with anti-thrashing protection
configure_context_compressor: configure a context compressor with model, threshold percentage, and head/tail message protection settings
